independent_outcomes: Remove the briefless-terminal shape for split parents: fix state derivation to handle briefless-close-marker bundles, and fix split.accept to generate and preserve a parent brief when splitting an iterated parent
proposed_seams: Between state.py (state derivation logic, lines 301-307) and split.py (accept transaction, lines 828-878): state.py change is defensive and handles any briefless-close-marker bundle; split.py change is specific to creating the parent brief during split. Both are required for criteria (a-f) to pass. Criterion (e) is testable independently (build briefless-close-marker shape directly); criteria (a-d) test the full accept flow. Despite two implementation loci, they are mutually dependent and must ship together as one fix.
